subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: What selected-versus-resolved model and provider-reported cost contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter auto runs across assistant records, session/status surfaces, usage templates, and response footers?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix changes public runtime/session semantics and exact-versus-estimated cost wording; automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add unified metadata contract
options.body: Define additive resolved-model and provider-cost metadata once at the transport boundary, persist it separately from selected model and estimated cost, and use it across all display and agent surfaces.

options.title: Limit to footer display
options.body: Add only the requested footer label and cost rendering, accepting that session_status, transcripts, and agent runtime metadata may continue to diverge.

options.title: Split across canonical issues
options.body: Keep this item open as the OpenRouter-specific request while letting broader cost and actual-model API issues define their own contracts first.

recommendation.title: Add unified metadata contract
recommendation.body: Define additive resolved-model and provider-cost metadata once at the transport boundary, persist it separately from selected model and estimated cost, and use it across all display and agent surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent path history and prior review context on OpenRouter cost reconciliation, OpenAI-compatible transport, and the cross-surface contract question.
